edges.reason: initialize() passes msg.sender to __initialize so the caller receives DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, PAUSER_ROLE and UPGRADER_ROLE.
__initialize uses msg.sender as the account receiving every administrative role.
_msgSender returns the caller address and is used as the authorisation principal.
unwrap burns tokens directly from msg.sender without any allowance or role restriction.
_grantRole emits RoleGranted with _msgSender() as the sender.
The wrapper parameter supplied to initialize(address) is forwarded to the internal initializer.
wrapper flows into _setupRole(WRAPPER_ROLE, wrapper) inside __initialize.
extID is used to read and then set _extIDs to prevent replay of the same external id.
to is the recipient passed to _mint inside wrap.
amount is the value minted inside wrap.
extTo is emitted as the external unwrap destination.
newImplementation is passed to _authorizeUpgrade, which only checks UPGRADER_ROLE.
newImplementation and data from upgradeToAndCall end in a delegatecall.
newImplementation is the target stored in the EIP1967 implementation slot by upgradeTo.
fromBalance feeds the unchecked subtraction _balances[from] = fromBalance - amount.
accountBalance feeds the unchecked subtraction _balances[account] = accountBalance - amount.
_extIDs[extID] is read by wrapped(extID) inside the wrap preconditions.
wrap writes _extIDs[extID] = true before minting.
wrap calls _mint(to, amount) to increase supply.
_mint increases _totalSupply through super._mint.
_mint credits _balances[account] with the supplied amount.
_mint compares totalSupply()+amount against cap() before minting.
unwrap calls _burn on the caller balance.
_burn writes the decremented balance into _balances.
_burn decreases _totalSupply by amount.
_burn performs an unchecked subtraction on the cached account balance.
_transfer updates _balances[from] and _balances[to].
_transfer performs the unchecked subtraction of the transferred amount.
initialize() delegates all role configuration to __initialize(msg.sender).
initialize(address) delegates all role configuration to __initialize(wrapper).
pause() is restricted by onlyRole(PAUSER_ROLE) and calls _pause().
pause() reads the PAUSER_ROLE constant for the access check.
unpause() is restricted by onlyRole(PAUSER_ROLE) and calls _unpause().
unpause() reads the PAUSER_ROLE constant for the access check.
wrap() is guarded by onlyRole(WRAPPER_ROLE).
_authorizeUpgrade is guarded by onlyRole(UPGRADER_ROLE).
upgradeTo calls _authorizeUpgrade before mutating the implementation slot.
upgradeToAndCall calls _authorizeUpgrade before mutating the implementation slot.
upgradeTo forwards to _upgradeToAndCallUUPS after authorisation.
upgradeToAndCall forwards to _upgradeToAndCallUUPS after authorisation.
_upgradeToAndCallUUPS reaches _functionDelegateCall, transferring control to supplied code.
_functionDelegateCall performs a delegatecall to an attacker-influenced implementation.
Delegatecall and raw call paths hand execution control to external code before state finalisation.
_transfer invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before updating balances.
_mint invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_burn invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
whenNotPaused reads _paused to decide whether transfers are allowed.
_setupRole grants a role by calling _grantRole with no caller verification.
_grantRole writes _roles[role].members[account] = true.

Amount parameter consumed by _mint through wrap.
Replay-protection key only used by wrap and the _extIDs mapping.
External destination parameter only meaningful inside unwrap.
wrapper is immediately forwarded to __initialize which grants WRAPPER_ROLE.
Implementation address is validated by the upgrade authorisation hook.
Cached balance exists solely to perform the unchecked subtraction in _transfer.
Cached balance exists solely to perform the unchecked subtraction in _burn.
